links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot answers to guideline-based salivary gland cancer clinical questions
links.effect: DeepSeek 86.9%, Gemini 78.9%, ChatGPT-4o 72.8%, Perplexity 71.6% accuracy; not sufficient for standalone clinical use.
links.quote: DeepSeek achieved the highest accuracy rate at 86.9%, followed by Gemini at 78.9%, ChatGPT-4o at 72.8%, and Perplexity at 71.6%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of four LLM chatbots (DeepSeek, Gemini, ChatGPT-4o, Perplexity) on 30 clinical guideline questions regarding salivary gland cancer without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
